reviews.text:
After being told there was "something slightly wrong" at another hospital, I visited this clinic for a second opinion, feeling very anxious.

The diagnosis was "heart disease," and I almost panicked at first, but the doctor explained everything carefully, breaking down the technical terms into simple terms. They listened patiently to my questions and anxieties, even though I had no prior knowledge, and gave me specific advice on things to be careful about in my pet's life and treatment options, which was extremely helpful.

The overall atmosphere of the hospital was warm, and I feel confident entrusting my beloved pet to them.

This has been a great guide for learning how to manage my pet's illness. I am truly grateful.

The veterinarian and staff are all very gentle, kind, and the animal hospital has a friendly atmosphere.

I trust their knowledge and skills, of course, but I also appreciate that they listen carefully to what I have to say and explain technical matters clearly and politely, even to a layperson like me.

I feel comfortable consulting them about even the smallest things, such as my pet's diet, supplements, and daily health management.

I hope to continue using their services for a long time.

Let me say this first: This was the worst experience I've ever had at a pet hospital. I used their services today, and when my pet was startled and hissed, they started making all sorts of complaints and insults, saying things like it was because my pet had a bad temperament. They even showed me pictures of injuries my pet had sustained from another cat, making me feel like my pet was being insulted. Finally, they just gave us some supplements and that was it. If they continue to treat us like this, I will never want to use their services again. My whole family is furious. I will also be sharing this review with other pet lovers.

Please improve your service for the sake of future customers.

I would like a response to this comment.

In May 2025, my Chihuahua underwent spaying surgery.

Pre-operative examinations were conducted on the morning of the surgery, and the surgery itself took place in the afternoon.

She stayed overnight and returned home the following day.

As explained beforehand, there was no Elizabethan collar, no stitches to remove, and no surgical gown.

Upon picking her up, we were told to bring her in for a post-operative check-up if the wound showed any particular symptoms, and that there should be no other issues. Walks were permitted from the same day.

She had a good appetite from the day after the surgery, didn't lick the wound, and is living her life as before.

The wound healed completely after a week, and is now almost invisible after three weeks.

It was a low-stress procedure for both the dog and the owner, and I recommend that anyone considering spaying their dog consult with this clinic.
Thank you for the high rating!

The doctors are very kind, humble and polite, so I always feel at ease. I have several toy poodles, and they always provide appropriate treatment for any symptoms they have. In addition to being a hospital equipped with the latest equipment, I also think it's great that they actively participate in conferences and other events to stay up to date with the latest medical information. The cost is also reasonable, and if you make a reservation, you won't have to wait.

Thank you for your high rating.
We are very happy that you were satisfied with your consultation.
All of our staff will continue to work hard to ensure that you can use our services with peace of mind.
